name: Plexo
description: Plexo is an open-source, AI-powered project management platform designed to simplify task planning, management, and collaboration. It uses AI to help generate and organize the work needed to complete software projects.
why: Plexo combines project management with AI-assisted task planning. It is self-hostable and open source, giving development teams an alternative to traditional project-management tools while keeping control of their infrastructure and data.
